tokens.usage: Hairline borders between rows and around cards. Decorative only (below 3:1).

tokens.name: on-ink-muted

tokens.name: ink-line

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The solid 2px focus ring, 2px offset, on bg and surface (3:1+ in both themes). On ink surfaces use on-ink-focus.

tokens.name: on-ink-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on ink surfaces (nav, footer, sidebar).

tokens.usage: Warning pill and banner ground. Text on it: warning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Overdue, failed, unbalanced, destructive actions. Text on bg/surface.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger pill and error banner ground. Text on it: danger.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral system notices, sent, scheduled. Kept blue so it never reads as the brand violet.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info pill and notice ground. Text on it: info.
